2608.23635.title: ToolRobustBench: Stage-Wise Perturbation Evaluation and Failure Diagnosis for Tool-Calling Agents
2608.23635.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) rely on tool calling as a fundamental agent capability, enabling them to invoke external systems and complete tasks beyond text generation. However, clean end-to-end (E2E) success cannot identify where a tool-use failure originates or how it propagates through a call. We introduce ToolRobustBench, a stage-wise diagnostic benchmark for tool-calling agents, where a tool-calling agent is an LLM system that selects a tool, supplies structured arguments, and interprets its returned feedback. ToolRobustBench aligns four perturbation families with the tool-use pipeline: tool-interface, user-intent, tool-output/observation, and runtime-environment perturbations. It attributes failures to tool selection, schema grounding, argument binding, tool-output/runtime-feedback handling, and E2E task success. Experiments on 15,456 single-family instances across 7 models, 16 sampled local tools, 4 perturbation families, and 14 subtypes show high but non-uniform clean performance and substantial robustness degradation, with tool-output/observation perturbation the dominant bottleneck. Mixed-family experiments reveal non-additive failure patterns that are not explained by isolated single-family results. Thus, ToolRobustBench provides a deterministic and cascade-aware benchmark for diagnosing robustness beyond clean tool-calling accuracy;
2608.23635.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）依賴工具調用作為基本的代理能力，使其能夠調用外部系統並完成超出文本生成的任務。<lb/>然而，純粹的端到端（E2E）成功無法識別工具使用失敗的來源或其在調用過程中的傳播方式。<lb/>我們介紹了ToolRobustBench，一個針對工具調用代理的階段性診斷基準，其中工具調用代理是選擇工具、提供結構化參數並解釋其返回反饋的LLM系統。<lb/>ToolRobustBench 將四個擾動類別與工具使用管道對齊：工具介面、用戶意圖、工具輸出/觀察和運行時環境擾動。<lb/>它將失敗歸因於工具選擇、架構基礎、參數綁定、工具輸出/運行時反饋處理和E2E任務成功。<lb/>在7個模型、16個抽樣本地工具、4個擾動類別和14個子類型中，對15,456個單一家庭實例的實驗顯示出高但不均勻的清晰性能和顯著的穩健性降級，其中工具輸出/觀察擾動是主要瓶頸。<lb/>混合家庭實驗揭示了非加性失敗模式，這些模式無法通過孤立的單一家庭結果來解釋。<lb/>因此，ToolRobustBench 提供了一個確定性和級聯意識的基準，用於診斷超越清晰工具調用準確性的穩健性；
